items.title: Tesla Full Self-Driving v15 rollout begins: full release notes and improvements

items.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch intelligence-gathering satellites for the National Reconnaissance Office
items.teaser: The NROL-136 mission will be the fourth launch of the year supporting the agency’s proliferated architecture satellite constellation in low Earth orbit. Liftoff from pad 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base is scheduled during a window that opens at 4:16 a.m. PST (7:16 a.m. EST / 1216 UTC).
